notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45497050/b086effc893034f14ce21f9cc61c306f61502012.png

🧜‍♀️ Hey, newbie! I don't think we've met? That's okay, let’s introduce ourselves! 🧜‍♀️

My name is Parsithea - I'm the hostess at the Crossroads Hotel and its charming face. But first and foremost, of course, a hostess! Today I'm going to tell you about what has changed at our hotel since your last visit. Get ready, it's about to get interesting! 💋

You can join the hotel staff HERE 👇 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45497050/456f03211266b1fd64b7128a2ad03ba5b197a686.png

Hotel Tales’ development doesn't stop for a second: new mini-games, backgrounds and characters are in the works, and the Hotel universe is growing fresh lore every day. But that's not all - another demo is in the active stage of development, where a new heroine - Parsithea - is waiting for you, as well as some cool art! 🔥🔥🔥

A little bit of information about the new heroine: 

Once upon a time, Parsithea fell in love with a handsome prince and decided to trade her tail for a pair of shapely legs to please him. The romance lasted a week and after that the prince married the princess, leaving Parsithea alone. The spell that gave her legs begins to wear off over time, so Parsithea looks more and more like a mermaid every day. However, the more she resembles a mermaid, the better she sings.

Add Hotel Tales to your wishlist and all your dreams will come true! 😍

notes.title: Hotel Tales - TopHouse's first T-rated project ⚡️
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/0952feb59610365b79d5f3b67389f17fe91cc3f7.png

✨ Welcome to the Hotel, dear guest! ✨

Come inside the foyer, have a seat. Don’t feel rushed, you’re right where you need to be. And while you’re waiting for the bellboy, I’ll tell you what resides inside the Hotel’s walls. Are you intrigued?

Just click one button, and your journey will begin right now.

You won’t refuse the Hotel’s owner, right?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/efbe621786b974af084709391d27ea942dee9344.jpg
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/ac400d89c3e08f4b29618d65f3c3b0002d984ce5.jpg
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/53523d2e84debb66f4f7f2bee15f5d7bb4143071.jpg
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/ec0f2e3c0bdae257d7ebba1a8187d18ab0a288a7.jpg

Hotel Tales is a work simulator where you play as an employee of a hotel on the crossing of worlds. Dive into breathtaking, chilling and amusing stories of your guests and colleagues, uncover the Hotel’s mysteries and try to make it until your probation ends!

🗝 Work in the Hotel

- Check-in: choose an appropriate room, accounting the guest’s wishes and likes.
- Room service: deliver food, go on errands and help with the guest’s everyday problems.
- Conflict resolution: solve complex situations between guests or colleagues - this will affect your relationship with them.

🗝 Interactive Elements

- Guests: their tasks will vary, from cooking unique recipes (such as potions) to helping find lost things (or guests!) in their rooms.
- Kicking back: you can have dinner with your guests and employees, have weekends to go on adventures with friends, engage in photography or collect stickers.

🗝 Social Interactions

- Relationships with colleagues: these can vary from friendly to romantic. Every character has their story and approach. How they develop is entirely up to you!
- Your choices made during the workday will impact not only the immediate environment, but the game’s ending.

🗝 Endings

- The ending depends on how good you performed your duties, who you developed a relationship with and what key choices you’ve made.
- Replayability: romantic endings, Hotel’s mysteries unraveling or even leading to it’s destruction (if things go horribly wrong). Collect them all!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/13b7339a45fde1c6d5ac398dae28b26b5e36e7fa.png

Join the Hotel’s staff and become something more than a guest! You just have to wishlist Hotel Tales on Steam. We’ll wait for your first shift with great anticipation!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/
